business_problem: Milpark Education, a South African higher education provider, faced operational challenges in student support.
solution_summary: Milpark Education built its Microsoft solution to improve customer-service and conversational-support workflows. Milpark Education, a South African higher education provider, faced operational challenges in student support. Key components included Microsoft Copilot Studio coordinated workflows, prompts, or deployment, and Dynamics 365 Customer Service delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users. Requests and business records enter Dynamics 365 Customer Service, where Microsoft Copilot Studio assists routing, summaries, or responses before the updated information is surfaced back to employees and customers through the Microsoft application layer. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft. Equipped with greater visibility, Milpark Education has reduced resolution times by 50% and escalation times by over 30%.
